inlines.v: ITIN'ERANT, adjective [Latin iter, a way or journey.] Passing or traveling about a country; wandering; not settled; as an itinerant preacher. ITIN'ERANT, noun One who travels from place to place, particularly a preacher; one who is unsettled.
